motivation.text: Show up for the first ten minutes; the rest has a way of following.

discipline.text: Show up on the dull days; that is where the habit gets its spine.

money.text: Spend less on appearance and more on ownership, patience, and time you control.

mindset.text: Fear is a loud passenger; you are still the one driving.

fact.text: Sharks existed before trees did, and their skeletons are made of cartilage.

books.text: You cannot always choose your circumstances, but you can choose your stance toward them.
books.credit: Idea from Man's Search for Meaning by Viktor E. Frankl

stoic.text: Much of today's heaviness is tomorrow's imagination arriving early.
